title: 实现 Web/API 只读浏览闭环
risks: No executable production CoreServer host, identity-provider/login issuance, Npgsql connection composition or deployment configuration is included; this is a verified adapter/UI slice, not a deployed product.
Production multi-instance hosts must provide a shared persistent ASP.NET Data Protection key ring or outstanding protected cursors can expire on restart or instance changes.
Permission-management write APIs and UI remain intentionally closed; granting the runtime direct table access would violate the completed least-privilege boundary.
Migration 8 adds stored generated columns and indexes to filesystem_entry; a large existing production table still needs a separately planned lock, disk-space, rollback and rollout assessment.
The 100,000-entry index and browser-windowing evidence does not replace the scheduled 500,000-item NAS/P95, database-space, multi-instance and release recovery exercises.

architecture_review.module: GatewayAuth permission-filtered read application/infrastructure plus the official Web AssetLink adapter
reused_existing_logic: V01-003 checksum-pinned forward-only migration manifest, module schema ownership/default privileges, backup/restore tooling and task-local PostgreSQL 16.15 integration harness
V01-004/V01-005 .NET 10/C# 14 value objects, application ports, bounded operations, structured privacy-safe logging and solution quality gates
LibraryStorage resource-library identity and availability contracts and AssetIdentity stable entry/relative-path physical-fact contracts
Frozen generated AssetLink .NET and TypeScript SDK codecs and the existing SDK generation, dependency and contract regressions
Existing repository verifier, architecture baseline, CI tier contract and v0.1-start release gate
duplicated_logic: Input bounds and result invariants are intentionally checked at HTTP/contracts/application boundaries and again in PostgreSQL SECURITY DEFINER functions across separate trust boundaries; shared PostgresReadExecutor and generated AssetLink codecs remove same-layer duplication.
cross_module_access: LibraryStorage exclusively owns library_permission and grants only catalog/permission security-barrier views to the GatewayAuth owner.

AssetIdentity exclusively owns present physical facts and grants only bounded browse/search SECURITY DEFINER functions to the GatewayAuth owner; hashes, absolute roots and scan internals are excluded.
GatewayAuth runtime can execute only four final permission-filtered functions and cannot directly read source projections, principals or mutate any table.
HTTP and React consume GatewayAuth/AssetLink public contracts and never reference another module's Infrastructure or PostgreSQL schema directly.
contracts/assetlink/** and generated SDK sources are unchanged.
new_language_or_framework: No new primary language; activates the approved TypeScript Web budget with React 19.2.8 and Vite 8.2.2.
new_major_dependencies: Npgsql 10.0.3 (PostgreSQL License), pure managed PostgreSQL adapter; tracked through NuGet and Npgsql GitHub security advisories.
React 19.2.8 and react-dom 19.2.8 (MIT) plus @tanstack/react-virtual 3.14.10 (MIT) for the browser runtime.
Playwright 1.62.1 (Apache-2.0), Vite 8.2.2 (MIT), TypeScript 6.0.3 (Apache-2.0), Prettier 3.9.6 (MIT) and exact React types as build/test-only dependencies.
Node.js 24.20.0 and pnpm 11.19.0 are exact build toolchain pins; all direct and transitive Web packages have reviewed licenses, integrity hashes and advisory sources.
contract_changes: LibraryStorage public contracts add LibraryAccessLevel while LibraryStorage remains the sole authorization-state owner.
GatewayAuth adds module-owned authenticated subject, bounded page/cursor, browse/search result and V0.1 operation-body contracts; the canonical AssetLink wire schema is unchanged.
Production migration manifest grows contiguously from versions 1-6 to 1-9 with owner-scoped permission state, read projections/indexes and GatewayAuth read functions; no applied migration is edited.
External error behavior is frozen as generic 401/400/404/413/415/503/504 AssetLink envelopes without existence or sensitive-detail leakage.
architecture_tests: 13 WebGateway MSTest cases plus the full 103-test .NET solution, locked restore, format, Release build, dependency/source policy and vulnerability report
39 static database/tool tests and 14 required PostgreSQL 16.15 integration tests, including authorization, revocation, least privilege, 100,000-entry indexes and restart persistence
37 repository, 14 architecture, 14 generated-SDK Python and 21 AssetLink contract/spike tests
6 Chromium UI regressions plus Web frozen install, format/lint/type/build, npm audit, license/integrity/source and bundle-size gates
Repository verifier, migration manifest, handoff validator, architecture baseline, v0.1-start release gate, git diff and Python-cache residue checks
technical_debt: Implement a production CoreServer composition root with a real host authentication scheme, bounded Npgsql data source and persistent shared Data Protection key ring.
Add separately owned permission-management commands/UI with unified authorization, audit and conflict policy; do not expose direct permission-table writes.
Plan migration 8 rollout against representative existing data with lock timing, disk-space failure, rollback and restore verification.
Implement SearchDedup-owned tags, ratings, OCR/AI and ranked/fuzzy search without moving policy or write ownership into GatewayAuth/Web.
Run scheduled 500,000-item NAS/P95, multi-instance, database-space and release/recovery profiles before enabling production publication or any physical write path.
